title: Trumpet with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Bell (flared front) -->
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="52" rx="14" ry="18" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="52" rx="9" ry="13" fill="#FFA500"/>
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="52" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#FF8C00"/>
  
  <!-- Bell rim highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="52" rx="14" ry="18" fill="none" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Main tube body -->
  <rect x="20" y="44" width="55" height="16" rx="3" fill="#FFD700"/>
  
  <!-- Tube highlight -->
  <rect x="20" y="46" width="55" height="5" rx="2" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  
  <!-- Tube shadow edge -->
  <rect x="20" y="56" width="55" height="3" rx="1" fill="#E8B800"/>
  
  <!-- Lead pipe (left end) -->
  <rect x="10" y="47" width="14" height="10" rx="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <rect x="10" y="48" width="14" height="3" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  
  <!-- Mouthpiece -->
  <ellipse cx="8" cy="52" rx="5" ry="7" fill="#DAA520"/>
  <ellipse cx="8" cy="52" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <ellipse cx="8" cy="52" rx="1.5" ry="3" fill="#B8860B"/>
  
  <!-- Valve casing 1 -->
  <rect x="33" y="30" width="8" height="32" rx="2" fill="#E8B800"/>
  <rect x="34" y="30" width="6" height="32" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <!-- Valve button 1 -->
  <ellipse cx="37" cy="30" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <ellipse cx="37" cy="30" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FFF59D"/>
  
  <!-- Valve casing 2 -->
  <rect x="47" y="26" width="8" height="36" rx="2" fill="#E8B800"/>
  <rect x="48" y="26" width="6" height="36" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <!-- Valve button 2 -->
  <ellipse cx="51" cy="26" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <ellipse cx="51" cy="26" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FFF59D"/>
  
  <!-- Valve casing 3 -->
  <rect x="61" y="30" width="8" height="32" rx="2" fill="#E8B800"/>
  <rect x="62" y="30" width="6" height="32" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <!-- Valve button 3 -->
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="30" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="30" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FFF59D"/>
  
  <!-- Finger loop under tube -->
  <path d="M 42 60 Q 42 70 50 70 Q 58 70 58 60" fill="none" stroke="#DAA520" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 42 60 Q 42 70 50 70 Q 58 70 58 60" fill="none" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Smiling face on the main tube body -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="51" r="2.5" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="50.5" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <circle cx="56" cy="51" r="2.5" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="50.5" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M 42 56 Q 47 61 52 56" fill="none" stroke="#1A1A2E" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="55" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#FF8C69" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="55" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#FF8C69" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
